item.title: How to Walk Into a Room With Confidence: 8 Rules for Women
item.description: The room is yours. 8 rules for walking into any room like you were expected: decide what you're there for, pause at the door, take a real seat, speak in the first ten minutes, drop the apology and back the other woman who spoke up. Confidence tips for women. Read the 8 rules on Satin Alibi.

item.title: Sit at the front of the room: confidence habits for women at work
item.description: Small confidence habits that change how a room treats you: sit at the front, speak in the first ten minutes, drop the apology. Practical, loud, and a little wicked. Read the full list on Satin Alibi.

item.title: Arrive, don't enter: confidence quotes for bold women
item.description: There's a difference between entering a room and arriving in it. Confidence quotes and practical tips for women who want to be seen and heard. Read more on Satin Alibi.

item.title: Take Up Space: Confidence Quotes for Women Who Are Too Much (in the Best Way)
item.description: Take up space, then take a little more. A short essay on being called too much and hearing it as a compliment: loud women, big laughs, taking up room without apologizing. Vintage black and white dance photography, confidence quotes for women and self-respect inspiration. Read it on Satin Alibi.

item.title: Take up space quotes: empowering words for bold women
item.description: You were never meant to fit in the margins. Empowering quotes for bold women who take up space and cheer each other on. Save this one and read the full essay on Satin Alibi.

item.title: Walk in like you were expected: how to walk into a room with confidence
item.description: Confidence tips for women who want to own every room: how to walk in, where to stand, what to say first, and why you never need to apologise for arriving. Read the full guide on Satin Alibi and save it for your next big entrance.

item.title: Say it first, say it loud: confidence quotes for outspoken women
item.description: Confidence isn't always quiet. Sometimes it's the first voice in the room. A reminder for outspoken women that speaking up is a strength. Read the full essay on Satin Alibi.

item.title: Never lower your voice or your standards: self-respect quotes for women
item.description: Your voice, your standards, your hemline, your expectations: keep them where you set them. Empowering quotes for women who refuse to shrink. Read the full piece on Satin Alibi and pass it to the friend who needs it.
